body:
Someone discovers the old hurt and the banned want have the same address.

When they finally tell the wounded thing and the forbidden thing together, the two make one story: the ambition mocked early, the appetite punished young.

With Chiron conjunct Lilith, people carry the injury that healed crooked and the want banished in the same incident, and this week the two answer to one name.

That is why everyone who treated either alone kept failing.

The combined story may be heavy to tell, but shame thins when people stop keeping the want and the wound in separate files.
